_readme: Synthrax seed data v3.1, written by Ethan (pharmacy lead). All people and places are fictional. Times are 24h local. 'demo_now' is the moment the 6pm round starts in the demo; all event times are given as hours relative to it (negative = in the past). 'scheduled_time' and 'given_at' are HH:MM on the same day as the event's t_hours (e.g. an event at t_hours -24 with given_at '18:00' means 18:00 yesterday). Drug-name matching must ignore case ('Warfarin' = 'warfarin') and should also check each medication's 'aliases'. The 'high_risk' and 'time_critical' flags on each medication must be kept in step with the two drug lists.
_changes_v1_to_v2: INR sample moved from -22h to -32h (10:00 yesterday) so it is clearly outside the 24h R1 window at the 6pm round; R1 message updated to match
M6 furosemide stock raised from 3 to 10 so R5 does not fire on load; the '3 left in the pack' carer note now triggers it
DOSE_GIVEN gained 'scheduled_time' and 'given_at' so R4 can measure lateness; Arthur's late-dose note now expects an R4 SAFETY_FLAG
Methotrexate once-weekly check moved out of interaction_checks_R6 into its own frequency_checks_R6 list
R7 threshold lowered from 4h to 2h so it no longer sits exactly on the boundary; a script step shows it firing on the GP side at -2h
RX_CREATED starting events now include 'drug' and 'times' and use the same dose wording as the medications list
Added 'aliases' to residents and medications (Mags, Sinemet, water tablet)
Expected REPEAT_REQUESTED now includes 'quantity'; the non-schema 'note' key was renamed '_comment'
_changes_v2_to_v3: Added Arthur's 08:00 and 16:00 co-careldopa doses to starting_events so R4 does not raise false 'missed dose' flags on load. His 12:00 dose is deliberately missing: R4 shows it as 'not recorded', then his carer note turns it into 'given 45 min late'
Added RX_CONFIRMED event (GP: 'INR in range, continue same dose'). Without it, R1 would fire after every INR even when the dose doesn't need changing
Added rule_notes: R1 is checked when the dose is due; R4 and R5 skip PRN medicines; R4 replaces a 'missing' flag with a 'given late' flag rather than showing both; boundary definitions
Margaret's 'bloods this morning' note marked as NOT for the live demo (it would reset R1's 24h clock)
Mags fall note: expected paracetamol dose now matches the medication list wording ('1g (2 tablets)')
Added sertraline + ibuprofen (stomach bleed risk) to interaction_checks_R6
_changes_v3_to_v3_1: SAFETY_FLAG severity now includes 'block' and 'pharmacist review', which R6 uses
_readme now explains that scheduled_time and given_at are HH:MM on the day given by t_hours

rule_notes.R1: Checked when a dose of the affected drug is due (i.e. at the round), not the moment the network drops. Fires only if ALL are true: an INR_taken observation is older than the window; no RX_CHANGED, RX_CONFIRMED or RX_STOPPED for that drug has been received since it; and the care home is currently offline from the GP. For the hackathon, implement R1 for INR_taken -> anticoagulants (warfarin) only. Holds only the affected drug, never the resident's other medicines.
rule_notes.R2: Fires at a dose of a high-risk drug when the care home has had no sync with the GP for MORE than 24h. Severity warn: needs a second staff signature.
rule_notes.R3: Compare the scanned pack_code with the local record. Pack version newer -> hold ('newer prescription exists'). Pack version older -> hold ('do not use this old pack'). Pack resident or medication different from the one being given -> hold ('wrong pack').
rule_notes.R4: Time-critical drugs only (check aliases, e.g. Sinemet). Never applies to PRN. A dose is late if given MORE than 30 min after scheduled_time. If a scheduled dose has no DOSE_GIVEN or DOSE_WITHHELD by scheduled_time + 30 min, flag it as 'not recorded'. If a DOSE_GIVEN for that dose arrives later, replace the 'not recorded' flag with a single 'given late' flag.
rule_notes.R5: Skip PRN medicines entirely (no fixed times, so days-left cannot be calculated). Days left = stock_doses / number of times per day. Fires if days left is LESS than 7 and there is no open REPEAT_REQUESTED for that medication. Draft quantity = 28 days' supply.
rule_notes.R6: Run when an RX_CREATED or RX_CHANGED arrives at the pharmacy, before DISPENSED is allowed. Compare against all of that resident's current medicines. Case-insensitive, check aliases.
rule_notes.R7: GP side. Fires when an RX_CHANGED has had no RX_ACKNOWLEDGED from the care home for 2h or more.

Care home is offline and has no RX_CHANGED. Rule R1 fires: SAFETY_FLAG severity=hold, message='INR taken 32h ago, no dosing instruction received, offline from GP for 6h. Hold warfarin and confirm dose with surgery or NHS 111.'
Rule R3: pack says v2, record says v1. SAFETY_FLAG hold: 'A newer prescription exists that you have not received.'
Logs merge; M1 now 3mg v2; care home sees the change and acknowledges it (RX_ACKNOWLEDGED); GP sees the dose was correctly held; no harm
